idea: A thrown ball keeps its horizontal speed while gravity changes its vertical speed, so its path is a parabola.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.why: From a gentle toss to a hard throw; at the top speed and the lowest gravity the path still fits the graph.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.why: Flat to steep throws; 0 and 90 degrees would hide one of the two velocity parts.

parameters.name: gravity
parameters.why: Half to twice Earth's gravity; zero gravity would never bring the ball down.

moves: The ball flies along its path over and over; the arrows ride with it and the vertical one shrinks to zero at the peak.
steps: The peak is where vertical velocity is zero
